title: Our goodbye

intro.bo: {nome}, when Mum or Dad leave you at school, how do you say goodbye? Choose together.
intro.pilu: A goodbye all of your own, {nome}: always the same, so you know they'll come back.
intro.tango: {nome}, let's make up a goodbye! A secret one that only you know.

offscreen: Use the same goodbye every morning, and keep it short: the longer it is, the harder it gets.

options.label: High five and off you go
options.outcome: Quick and cheerful. Then Mum or Dad go, and come back later.

options.label: A kiss in your hand
options.outcome: You keep it in your pocket all day. If you miss them, you squeeze it.

options.label: A wave from the window
options.outcome: You go in, they wave to you through the glass, then they go.

outro.bo: We did it, {nome}. I got a bit scared, but it worked out.
outro.pilu: Well done, {nome}, you looked carefully. That's enough for today.
outro.tango: Done! {nome}, tomorrow we'll do another one. Now I'm off running.
